items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally. Evidence: the security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days. Compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown, not certification. Exact decision: do not clear security-sensitive releases or claim certification; preserve private-launch gates. Permit only reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Continue the existing consolidated read-only security evidence matrix without creating duplicate work. Record dated evidence, unknowns, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain risk, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, incident response readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
